Dropdown

Add a dropdown list to any button.

Add a dropdown list to any button. The trigger’s data-target must match the id of the ul. A divider is an empty li with the divider class. Icons go inside the item’s <a>.

AutoInit() starts every .dropdown-trigger except those marked no-autoinit. Dropdowns open on click by default.

<!-- Dropdown Trigger -->
<a class="dropdown-trigger btn filled" href="#!" data-target="dropdown1">Drop Me!</a>
<!-- Dropdown Structure -->
<ul id="dropdown1" class="dropdown-content">
  <li><a href="#!">one</a></li>
  <li><a href="#!">two</a></li>
  <li class="divider" tabindex="-1"></li>
  <li><a href="#!">three</a></li>
  <li><a href="#!"><i class="material-icons">view_module</i>four</a></li>
  <li><a href="#!"><i class="material-icons">cloud</i>five</a></li>
</ul>

For a dropdown inside a top app bar, see Navbar Dropdown.

Initialization

The IIFE bundle exposes RoutePlate.Dropdown. Call init yourself when you need options other than the defaults, or let RoutePlate.AutoInit() start every .dropdown-trigger. 

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const elems = document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-trigger');
  const instances = RoutePlate.Dropdown.init(elems, {
    // specify options here
  });
});

Per-instance options can also be passed through AutoInit:

RoutePlate.AutoInit(document.body, {
  Dropdown: { constrainWidth: false }
});

Options

Name Type Default Description
alignment String 'left' Edge the menu is aligned to. 'left' or 'right'.
autoFocus Boolean true If true, automatically focus the dropdown for keyboard navigation. This option is named autoFocus, not autoTrigger.
constrainWidth Boolean true If true, the menu is as wide as the trigger.
container Element null Element that will contain the dropdown. When omitted, the menu is moved next to the trigger.
coverTrigger Boolean true If false, the menu opens below the trigger instead of covering it.
closeOnClick Boolean true If true, close the dropdown when an item is clicked.
hover Boolean false If true, the dropdown opens on hover instead of click.
inDuration Number 150 Enter transition duration, in milliseconds.
outDuration Number 250 Exit transition duration, in milliseconds.
onOpenStart Function null Called when the dropdown starts opening.
onOpenEnd Function null Called when the dropdown finishes opening.
onCloseStart Function null Called when the dropdown starts closing.
onCloseEnd Function null Called when the dropdown finishes closing.
onItemClick Function null Called when an item is clicked. Receives the li.
Examples

These two menus set constrainWidth: false so the list can be wider than the button, and use alignment to pick an edge.

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  RoutePlate.Dropdown.init(document.querySelector('#dropdown-left-trigger'), {
    alignment: 'left',
    constrainWidth: false
  });
  RoutePlate.Dropdown.init(document.querySelector('#dropdown-right-trigger'), {
    alignment: 'right',
    constrainWidth: false
  });
});

Hover is off by default. Pass hover: true to open on mouse enter instead of click.

Methods

All methods are called on the plugin instance. You can get the instance like this: 
const instance = RoutePlate.Dropdown.getInstance(elem);
.open();

Open the dropdown.

instance.open();
.close();

Close the dropdown.

instance.close();
.recalculateDimensions();

While the dropdown is open, recalculate its dimensions if its contents have changed.

instance.recalculateDimensions();
.destroy();

Destroy the plugin instance and tear down its event handlers.

instance.destroy();

Properties

Name Type Description
el Element The DOM element the plugin was initialized with (the trigger).
options Object The options the instance was initialized with.
id String ID of the dropdown content element.
dropdownEl Element The dropdown content element.
isOpen Boolean Whether the dropdown is open.
isScrollable Boolean Whether the dropdown content is scrollable.
focusedIndex Number Index of the focused item.
